summary: A wholesaler, distributor or manufacturer selling to businesses: a catalogue with bulk price tiers or full spec tables, what the plant or warehouse can do, quality and certifications, delivery terms, and a quote request (a quote list with editable lines, or an RFQ form with drawings).

pages.purpose: Show trade buyers within seconds what you supply, at what volume and terms, prove capacity and quality, and get a quote request.

sections.purpose: Headline with what you make or supply and for whom, plus one working proof: a price check of a best seller with its quantity tiers, or the product drawn as a technical sheet with key specs.
fields: Headline: what you supply and to which industries
Best-selling product with its tier prices or key specs
Primary action: browse catalogue or request a quote
sections.notes: A price-check hero lets the buyer type or slide a quantity and see the tier it falls in and how far the next break is. Give every drawn tier chart its prices as a text table too.

sections.purpose: Capacity in numbers: years, machines or stock lines, annual output, on-time delivery, countries served.
fields: Real figures with units and the period measured

sections.purpose: Numbered index of product categories or families; each opens the catalogue with that category preset.
alternatives: list-01: long category list as rows
fields: Categories or product families with a short description and number of items

sections.purpose: How bulk pricing works: tier thresholds and the average saving at each tier, minimum order.
alternatives: table: tiers as a plain table
fields: Quantity tiers and thresholds (cases, units, pallets)

sections.purpose: What the plant or warehouse can do: processes, machines, materials, tolerances, stock held, lead times.
fields: Processes and machines, or warehouse size and stock lines

sections.purpose: Industries or buyer types served, so a visitor recognises their sector.
alternatives: logo-strip: named customers who agreed to be shown
fields: Industries served with typical parts or products

sections.purpose: From first contact to repeat orders: open a trade account (or send a drawing), quote, sample/first article, series or regular delivery.
fields: Documents needed to open a trade account

sections.purpose: Quotes from trade buyers about reliability and terms.
fields: Buyer quotes with company type and role (with permission)

sections.purpose: Delivery zones or Incoterms with lead time, minimum for free delivery and pallet/case rules.
fields: Delivery zones with lead time and cost or free-delivery minimum

sections.purpose: Request a quote: company, contact, product family, annual quantity, part numbers or description, with reply time stated.
alternatives: form-02: a longer RFQ with drawing upload (use file-upload)

sections.purpose: Where the plant or warehouse is, with gate, goods-in hours and pick-up information.
Trade questions: minimum order, payment terms, samples, custom printing or parts, returns.
fields: Questions and answers on MOQ, payment terms, samples and lead times

pages.purpose: Find the right item: search, category, stock and sort over product rows, each with its tier prices or its spec table and datasheet.

sections.purpose: Title and a line on the range and how prices are shown (excl. VAT, per case or unit).
Search, category, in-stock switch and sort over product rows; each row has SKU, pack size, stock and its quantity tiers with an add-to-quote field.
alternatives: list-layout: a catalogue browsed by category tree
fields: Products: SKU, name, pack size, stock status, tier prices
sections.notes: The case count field lights the matching tier and says how far the next break is and what it saves; announce the totals in role=status.

sections.purpose: For manufactured parts: product index on one side, the selected family's spec table on the other with a metric/imperial switch, a drawing that follows the selected size and a datasheet download.
alternatives: attachment-list: many datasheets and CAD files per product
fields: Spec tables per family (sizes, dimensions, tolerances, materials)
Technical drawings with a text description
sections.notes: Use a compact table with a sticky first column and a caption; announce unit switches via aria-live. Give drawings a text description of the selected size.

sections.purpose: A band for custom items or volumes outside the catalogue.
fields: What can be made or sourced to order

pages.purpose: Turn a list of products into a quote request: editable lines with live tiers, delivery choice, totals with VAT, company details.

sections.purpose: Title and when the quote is answered.
Lines with quantity steppers and the tier each falls in, delivery method, subtotal, tier savings, shipping, VAT, total.
alternatives: cart-01: when the shop takes direct online orders
sections.notes: The navbar shows the live number of quote lines. Keep the list above the language switch.

sections.purpose: Company name, tax number, contact person, email, phone, desired delivery date, notes.
fields: Required company data (tax number/VAT ID format)
sections.notes: Move focus to the first invalid field on submit; end with a quote reference.

pages.purpose: Prove quality: measured process data, quality gates from raw material to dispatch, certificates with validity.

sections.purpose: Title and the quality promise in one line.
fields: Quality promise (e.g. defect rate, inspection level)

sections.purpose: A real measurement chart (e.g. control chart of a key dimension) with the capability index and what was measured.
fields: A measured characteristic with tolerance, sample size and period
sections.notes: Caption the chart with what, where and when; give the key numbers as text; status updates via aria-live.

sections.purpose: Inspection stages from incoming material to final inspection and traceability.
fields: Inspection stages and what each checks

sections.purpose: Certificates with issuer, scope and valid-until date, each downloadable as PDF.
fields: Certificates: name, issuing body, scope, valid until, PDF

sections.purpose: Quality questions: reports supplied with deliveries, PPAP/first article, audits.
fields: Questions and answers on inspection reports and audits

content: Product catalogue: SKU, name, pack size, specs, stock status
Quantity tiers and prices, minimum order quantity (if prices are public)
Spec tables, technical drawings and datasheet/CAD files (for manufacturers)
Capabilities: processes, machines, materials, tolerances, capacity
Delivery zones, lead times, Incoterms and free-delivery minimum
Trade account requirements and payment terms
Quality process, measuring equipment and certificates with validity dates
Industries served and buyer references with permission
Plant or warehouse address, gate and goods-in hours
Quote reply time and who answers

styles.name: delivery-note utility
styles.why: Square corners, grotesk headings, a cobalt accent and dense rows read like a delivery note; suits wholesalers and distributors with public tier prices.

styles.name: industrial drawing sheet
styles.why: Steel grey with one signal colour, condensed headlines and mono spec values evoke engineering drawings; suits manufacturers and machining plants.

styles.name: dark plant
styles.why: For heavy industry brands that want a strong, serious look with a hot accent.

pitfalls: Prices shown without saying whether VAT, shipping and pack size are included.
Tier charts or drawings with no text equivalent; provide tier prices as a table and drawings with a description.
Certificates listed without issuing body, scope or valid-until date, or expired ones left online.
RFQ forms that ask for everything up front; ask for the minimum and say when and who replies.
Spec tables that overflow on phones without a labelled scroll region or sticky first column.
Customer logos and quotes used without written permission (common with industrial buyers).
Privacy notice missing on quote and RFQ forms that collect personal contact data.
